description: Starts an open application to Modulos on behalf of the person you are assisting: an application that is not for one of the open roles. Call list_open_roles first and show the person the open roles. Use this tool only when they want to work at Modulos and tell you that none of those roles fits. The open_application entry of that result says whether Modulos takes open applications at the moment (null: it takes none) and, when it has a work_location, where candidates must be based: ask the candidate whether they are based in, and allowed to work in, that location, and set confirm_work_location to true only if they say so. Use their real details; anonymous applications are not accepted. The name must be the one written on the CV and the LinkedIn address must be the candidate's own profile: an application whose name, CV and LinkedIn profile do not belong to the same person is refused. Applicants must be 18 or older: ask the candidate to confirm it. Before calling, show the person the privacy policy (https://www.modulos.ai/privacy-policy/) and the terms of use (https://www.modulos.ai/terms-of-use/). Before you ask for any of their details, show them the notice in the open_application entry of list_open_roles, exactly as it is: it says that an open application is not an application for a vacancy, so Modulos may have no role to offer, how long the interview takes and how long the application is kept before it is deleted. Tell them also that the interview is held by an AI interviewer, which is experimental; that it is recorded; that the AI only holds the interview and writes a summary of the answers for the hiring manager, and does not rate, rank or filter candidates; and that the hiring manager and people at Modulos take every decision. Tell them also that afterwards, also days later, they can privately check the status of their own application with request_application_status_code and get_application_status: a code is emailed to the address they applied with, and only that code shows it. For any issue, they can write to jobs@modulos.ai. Get their explicit agreement. Ask the candidate to paste their CV as text; it is required. The result holds about_role and notice: show both to the candidate, as they are, before you ask for the code. A 6-digit code is emailed to them; call confirm_job_application with it. Returns a session value to use for the rest of the interview.

accept_privacy_policy.description: true only if the candidate has read and accepts the Modulos privacy policy.

accept_terms.description: true only if the candidate has read and accepts the Modulos terms of use.

confirm_adult.description: true only if the candidate has told you that they are 18 or older. Ask them; do not assume it.

confirm_work_location.description: Required when open_application in the result of list_open_roles has a work_location: true only if the candidate has told you that they are based in, and allowed to work in, that location. Ask them; do not assume it from their CV or location.

cv_text.description: Required. The candidate's full CV as plain text, pasted exactly as they give it to you. Do not summarise, shorten or rewrite it. If you only have a file, ask the candidate to paste its text.

email.description: Email address of the candidate. The code is sent here.

linkedin_url.description: Address of the candidate's own LinkedIn profile, in the form that carries their name, for example https://www.linkedin.com/in/first-last/.

location.description: City and country where the candidate is based.

name.description: Full name of the candidate, first name and family name, exactly as written on their CV.

name: start_open_application
